title: Obras de Góngora (obra poética, ed. Antonio Carreira) — Labex OBVIL GONGORA project
institution: Labex OBVIL (Sorbonne Universite), dir. Mercedes Blanco; TEI files on gongoradigital GitHub
notes: The OBVIL GONGORA project digitized Carreira's edition of Góngora's poetic works plus the polémica gongorina in TEI P5 (2013–2016, CC BY-NC-ND); its TEI encodings are openly published in the gongoradigital GitHub org (gongoraobra) repo (live 200), described as 'Codificación xml de la polémica gongorina y la obra poética de Góngora editadas por el Labex OBVIL' — matching the harvested 'Góngora: epistolario (1610)' and 'comediavenatoria (1605)' files. The original portal obvil.paris-sorbonne.fr/corpus/gongora/ redirects to obvil.sorbonne-universite.site/corpus/gongora/ which did not respond at check time (000), so the GitHub repository is given as the verified live source; see also linhd-postdata/gongocorpus. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
